title: Lab filters and preferences: Create a request-isolated Zustand 5 vanilla store with typed actions, stable selectors and derived visible rows; do not persist or duplicate server-owned catalogue data.
description: A complete Zustand 5 state-boundaries lesson using actual vanilla stores, targeted subscriptions and safe client state ownership, including a red starter and offline regression tests.
objectives: Create a request-isolated Zustand 5 vanilla store with typed actions, stable selectors and derived visible rows; do not persist or duplicate server-owned catalogue data.
Repair the zustand-filter-preference-capstone intentionally broken Zustand 5 starter.
Explain what belongs in local, URL or authoritative remote data state.
rubric: I can explain the state ownership principle for lab filters and preferences.
I can repair the 09.04.08 defect using actual Zustand 5 APIs.
I can identify persistence, privacy and hydration risks needing integration tests.
